title: VPC Onboarding — Networking flow, install steps, and upgrade UI visuals
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and deliver a set of onboarding visuals and annotated screenshots for Private/VPC onboarding flows in the Redwood Console and supporting docs. Deliverables include: 1) One-page high-level networking flow (simple and advanced variants) for the docs hero; 2) Step-by-step install hero graphics for CLI/Helm/Operator paths; 3) Full-fidelity upgrade UI mockups for the in-console upgrade modal (pre-check, running, success, failure/rollback); 4) A set of production-ready screenshots for release notes and the quickstart guide (dark + light). Visuals must be annotated for engineers and localized-ready (copy tokens). Aim for assets that fit the new console grid and match Redwood brand tokens.  Priority is to unblock engineering and docs for console-2026.04 release.
acceptance_criteria: High-level networking flow approved by Infra and PM: shows VPC peering, route table considerations, NAT/IGW options and optional on-prem VPN
Three install hero variants produced: CLI (single command), Helm chart (values snippet), Operator (CRD install) — each with annotated step numbers
Upgrade modal mockups include: pre-check state, progress streaming, success confirmation with next steps, and failure view with rollback option and diagnostic link
Screenshots exported in PNG and SVG, 2x and 3x scales, light and dark themes, filenames follow asset naming convention: 'vpc_onboard_<type>_<theme>_<size>.png'
Figma file handoff contains tokens, layer naming, and an assets page; engineering has a documented screenshot capture checklist
Design reviews resolved (PM + Eng comments closed) and a final Confluence page is ready for docs ingestion
